rules: Delegation transfers execution/decision latitude only inside declared limits; command responsibility remains with the commanding officer.
The captain may revoke or narrow delegation unless a superior/external authority has validly changed command authority.
A delegate cannot delegate more authority than they received.
Department heads may resolve detailed assignments beneath a captain/XO policy without requiring captain approval for every micro-decision unless the control mode says otherwise.
Changing control_mode is itself a persistent command decision.
